title: Landing: merge detection, branch cleanup and run pruning

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Merged branches should be detected and offered for cleanup (decision 49, list-and-detect; docs/dashboard.md:104). Runs are kept until landed (decision 36). Retention keeps the latest 100 finished runs but never removes a run whose branch is not landed (docs/state.md:200-207). runrec.Store.Prune already takes a landed predicate and removes nothing without one (internal/runrec/store.go:178-182). Nothing calls Prune yet; the only callers are in internal/runrec/runrec_test.go:375-381.
Decision 66 (head-only) fixes the change signal that refresh reads: git rev-parse HEAD per project. It does not decide whether a merge check may run.
docs/boundaries.md:17 says landing is outside ork in v1. That conflicts with decision 49, which is the one to follow. The boundaries row is stale.
Open: landing.merge-detect (adj check: not found). Ask the owner how ork detects a merged branch and when it may run, with options and a recommendation. Options include a check at run end or on owner request, a check on refresh, or reading slicer's land result.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/runrec/store.go:178-200 (Prune): no logic change expected. A caller is added.
- internal/runrec/runrec_test.go:355-385: keep the existing test; add the keep-100 case.
- internal/daemon/runs.go:111-137 (recoverRuns): a prune pass after recovery is one option (when it runs is Open).
- internal/daemon/landed.go (new; proposed name): the landed predicate. It reads the run's Branch (runrec.Record.Branch) and checks the branch against the project's HEAD with git. Depends on landing.merge-detect.
- internal/source/source.go:154-165 (EngineRun): a merged flag for the cleanup offer (proposed; shared with S09).
- internal/tui/overview.go: the cleanup offer (proposed; the Ready to land section belongs to S09).
- docs/state.md:200-207 (retention; name the landing detection once decided).
- docs/dashboard.md:102-104 (cleanup wording).
- docs/boundaries.md:17 (stale: landing outside ork in v1, against decision 49).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestPruneKeepsTheLatestHundredFinishedRuns: keeps 100 and removes the oldest finished runs beyond that only when landed (extends TestPruneKeepsTheLatestFinishedAndOnlyRemovesLanded, internal/runrec/runrec_test.go:355).
- TestPruneNeverRemovesUnlandedOrActiveRuns: a nil landed removes nothing (internal/runrec/store.go:178-181); an active run stays.
- TestLandedIsTrueOnlyForAMergedBranch: a branch that is an ancestor of HEAD is landed; an unmerged branch is not (fake git).
- TestRefreshReadsOnlyHeadPerProject: a dashboard refresh runs only git rev-parse HEAD per project (decision 66). This holds only if the owner keeps merge checks off refresh; see Why.md.
- TestMergedBranchIsOfferedNotRemoved: a merged branch gets a cleanup offer, and no worktree is removed without the owner (decision 36).
